description: Documented baseline, mapping and synthetic bench log; independent review, applicability and candidate suitability remain open.

brief.title: J12 connector review for Aster payload emulator
brief.issue: Prepare a review of a reported J12 link interruption during thermal vacuum using only the supplied records.
brief.goal: Compare retaining/investigating J12 with evaluating a replacement; identify what evidence the reviewer needs.
brief.constraints: Preserve the sensor signal mapping; other constraints must come from supplied records.
brief.conditions: Synthetic bench context: a payload interface emulator.
brief.decision: What is the justified next action before an engineering decision?

sources.name: Aster payload emulator — req (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Baseline register: Aster payload emulator, controller Rev B, harness Rev B.
J12 pin mapping: pin A = signal, pin B = return (invented mapping).
A connector replacement must preserve this mapping. Candidate geometry and materials suitability have not been assessed.

sources.name: Aster payload emulator — obs (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Aster payload emulator: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in a payload interface emulator.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during thermal vacuum.
This observation alone does not establish a cause or suitability for operational use.

sources.name: Aster payload emulator — log (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Synthetic chamber record: bench profile DEMO-SPACE-ASTER.
The note records 2 interruptions in 10 bench cycles under thermal vacuum.
The setup, cycle count and result are author-entered synthetic statements; they are not verified measurements.
The bench conditions have not been shown to represent the intended operational environment.
